location_exception_reason: Industrial Sheds are engineered structures quoted per sq ft of covered area and designed to buyer specifications (span, height, load class, roofing type); location of manufacture or seller headquarters does not change the product specification or buyer decision criteria. GI tagging or regional origin certification does not apply.
biz_exception_reason: Business-type words (Manufacturer, Supplier, Contractor, EPC Firm) describe who is selling, not what is being sold. IndiaMART's seller-type filter already exposes this independently. Removing 'Manufacturer' or 'Contractor' from a title leaves the product definition (e.g., 'PEB Industrial Shed, 50m span, 6m eave') complete and unchanged.
